violations.message: Project.create repeats the same trim-and-not-empty name check found in User.create. It holds `name` as a raw string, while Task uses a value object (TaskTitle) for this kind of validation. The shared name rule should live in one place, such as a value object.
User.create copies the trim-and-not-empty name check from Project.create, and it doesn't use the value-object pattern that Task uses for TaskTitle.
